F.state_keys: F_step_16_post_parameter_00 through _21 in stored model parameter order

bootstrap.advance_rule: advance only if one-sided 95% percentile lower score bound > 0.50
bootstrap.unit: 512 opening clusters; resample with replacement and carry both seat games together

estimated_execution_cost: 1,024 games × at most 200 decision plies × 1,200 simulations = 245,760,000 simulation budget upper bound, plus exact-root probes; actual wall time depends on native runtime throughput and game lengths. No arena run is performed in preparation.
export_semantics: both checkpoints exported using the same residual_v3 (96,3), kalah_v3 runtime exporter; shared runtime search_policy sidecar; synthetic policy/value parity against frozen parameter states is required before any real registration/execution
interpretation: exploratory direct strength evaluation on a newly registered suite; not fresh confirmation or an independently untouched holdout

exclusions.limitation: non-overlap with unresolved seed461 continuation population cannot be certified; seed461 root openings are represented where reconstructable, but trajectory state identities are not

opening_suite.generator: Python random.Random(488), legal rules-only prefixes of 4..12 plies; reject opening-root identity collisions against independently reconstructed seed482/483/484 identity pairs and previous selected roots

primary_score: F wins + 0.5 * draws, divided by all 1,024 games
promotion: No promotion from this experiment alone.
resumption: one atomic paired opening batch at a time; completed opening batches are receipt-bound and skipped on resume; duplicate, malformed, or incomplete batches reject

runtime.exact_root: shared frozen sidecar policy; threshold 16, final_score_margin objective, highest legal network prior then lowest move index tie rule, exact leaf solve disabled
runtime.max_moves_policy: At 200 decision plies, stop without sweeping remaining pits; compare captured stores at the cap. A game ending earlier uses Kalah terminal sweeping. Recorded trajectory length must be terminal before 200 or exactly 200.
runtime.native_runtime: same compiled native exact-root probe and tablebase for both arms, bound by hashes
runtime.seat_pairing: each opening is played twice with F in player 0 and player 1; same opening prefix and other settings
runtime.seed_contract: azlite_eval_seed_v2; per-opening base seed = 488 + opening_index; arena's deterministic seed contract binds opening state, seat, game-within-opening, and ply

seed479_and_480_classification: promising exploratory results; preserved as exploratory
supersedes: PR #487 seed488_prepared_not_executed registration and suite; this is a preparation-only correction before any outcomes
trajectory_contract: arena.py at the runtime source hash; opening prefixes and trajectories are player-relative v2 moves converted by KalahGame.pit_index at each ply; rules use KalahGame.move including extra turns and terminal sweep; stored margin is challenger captured store minus current captured store; winner is the sign of that margin
